options.text: A surgical procedure to unblock fallopian tubes
A method of contraception using hormones
A fertility treatment where eggs are fertilised outside the body and then implanted in the uterus
A natural method of increasing fertility through diet changes

questions.explanation: In IVF, eggs are collected from the ovaries after hormone stimulation, fertilised with sperm in a laboratory, and the resulting embryos are then transferred to the uterus for implantation.
